Class JobRequestMapper

java.lang.Object
com.example.tarecruitment.job.mapper.JobRequestMapper
public final class JobRequestMapper extends Object
JobRequestMapper - Job interface request conversion utility. Only responsible for converting HTTP path/form text to ordinary parameters usable by service, does not do permission check, does not directly read/write CSV.

  • Method Details

    • pathJobId

      public static String pathJobId(String pathInfo)
      Extract jobId from pathInfo of /api/jobs/{jobId}. Servlet only cares about first path segment, if /extra-like sub-paths appear later, it will not be mistaken as part of job ID.

    • trimToEmpty

      public static String trimToEmpty(String value)
      Coerce nullable text to empty string uniformly, to reduce null checks in service/validator.

    • normalizeSkillsToList

      public static List<String> normalizeSkillsToList(String rawSkills)
      Convert skills text in job form to list. Frontend submits comma-separated text, CSV model stores skills list; here only does format conversion, whether legal is still JobValidator responsibility.

    • parseWeeklyHours

      public static Double parseWeeklyHours(String weeklyHoursText)
      Parse weeklyHours field. Return null means user did not fill or format invalid, caller will decide based on validation result whether to use default value, keep old value, or return bad request.

    • parseDeadline

      public static LocalDateTime parseDeadline(String deadlineStr)
      Parse deadline submitted by browser datetime-local. Different browsers may submit second or minute precision, so try ISO, second, minute in order to ensure small differences in frontend controls do not break create/edit job.

    • formParameters

      public static Map<String,String> formParameters(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest request) throws IOException
      Manually parse PUT x-www-form-urlencoded request body. Compatibility note: POST forms generally can use request.getParameter, but PUT requests in some Servlet containers do not automatically populate parameter map.
      Throws:
      IOException

    • requestParameters

      public static Map<String,String> requestParameters(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest request, String... names)
      Read frontend submitted fields by whitelist. JobServlet passes JOB_FIELDS, ensuring unknown parameters do not bypass mapper to directly enter JobService creation flow.
